_about: Amendments enacted after the GovInfo edition this site uses (current through Jan. 6, 2025). Found by comparing each section's source credit with Cornell LII, which tracks the House's current code. The official text shown is not edited; these notes flag the difference.

1992.change: Changed a definition reference from "section 2101(31) of title 49" to "section 2101 of title 49". Technical; the prohibited conduct and penalties are unchanged.

2258A.change: Providers must now also preserve "all supplemental data included in the report", not only the contents of the report.
